description: RP2040 microcontroller for LLC converter telemetry monitoring (NOT control loop). 8-channel ADC monitoring + USB interface.

USB_DP.description: USB D+ data line (to USB_INTERFACE block)

USB_DM.description: USB D- data line (to USB_INTERFACE block)

ADC_IOUT_SENSE.description: Output current sensing (0-10A from shunt amplifier)

ADC_EFFICIENCY.description: Efficiency measurement input (Pin vs Pout calculation)

ADC_SPARE.description: Spare ADC input for future expansion

SWCLK.description: SWD clock input from debug probe

SWDIO.description: SWD data I/O from debug probe

RUN_RESET.description: RUN/RESET signal to debug header (allows external reset)

typical.notes: Varies with CPU activity. USB active adds ~10mA. ADC sampling adds ~5mA.

maximum.notes: Both cores at 133MHz, USB active, ADC continuous sampling

notes: RP2040 is for MONITORING ONLY - does NOT close LLC control loop
Control loop is handled by discrete analog circuitry (DISCRETE_LLC_CONTROLLER)
All 8 ADC channels monitor converter telemetry for logging and display
USB interface provides real-time data streaming to host PC
Firmware can calculate efficiency, log waveforms, detect faults
SWD debug interface allows firmware programming and debugging
